DocDigest.description: The 64-bit FNV-1a of the document's body as compact JSON, as 16 lowercase hex digits.

RelPath.description: A path relative to the project's root, with `/` between its parts and no empty, `.` or `..` part.

Version.description: A kind's schema version, <major>.<minor>, such as 1.0.

description: The body of a journal entry whose `event` is doc.written and whose `v` is 1.0.

kind.description: The document's kind, as its envelope names it.

part.description:
The id of the part the document is (`songs/<song>/parts/<part>…`), as its body states
it. Absent for anything but a part, and for a part that states none, such as a drum
grid.

path.description: Where, relative to the project's root.

replaced.description: Whether it replaced a file that was there.

song.description:
The id of the song whose folder holds the path (`songs/<song>/…`), as its `song.duet`
states it when the document was written. Absent outside a song's folder, or when the
folder holds no song that reads.

version.description: The kind's version it was written at.

title: duet journal event doc.written 1.0
